ru.codex: Scary little book of dark buddies

voice_notes: Wormwood speaks in short fragments with dropped articles and subjects, names things by childlike compounds (nightmare fuel is 'Dark Floaty Man', the moon 'Night Ball', ghosts 'Floaty Friend'), calls almost everything 'friend', and his loneliness shows in how eagerly he greets things ('Hello?'). Books are judged by whether they are nice or scary ('About Scary Arms', 'About friends!'), and mental strain is always 'head' ('Ow. Hurts head...'). The Portuguese drops articles the same way ('Machuca cabeça', 'Cadê cabeça?') and renders nicknames as literal noun phrases ('Homem Flutuante Escuro'). The Chinese uses reduplicated 黑黑的 and stiff-simple constructions like 伤害脑袋 and 别人的朋友. The Russian is plain and grammatical but clipped, mirrors 'Dead self!' as 'Мертвый я!', and uses 'Чей-то еще друг' for 'Someone else's friend'; I modelled shadow_mine and shadow_other directly on those two official patterns in every language. Revised: lines cut to four words or fewer (92% of his vanilla lines), 'friend' kept to one line (18% of his lines), and the Codex gets one of his descriptive nicknames.

line_notes.codex: His signature made-up nickname, built like 'Shaggy Buddy brusher': the shadows are dark buddies.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: Four words, with his official nickname for nightmare fuel.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: Short and simple, echoing his official 'Ow. Hurts head...'.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Built on his official 'Dead self!' line, and the lonely creature delighted that his own copy is a friend is the heart of the character.
line_notes.shadow_other: Patterned on his vanilla 'Someone else's friend'.
